name: Base counter desktop release
native_validation: Five unique sites including a surface base and a bare storage cluster; two estimated raids; both Storage ESP and Block ESP linked.
Actual vanilla trial-chamber assembly and ancient-city barracks with added dense storage rejected.
Real mouse + / - controls, duplicate visits, re-enable, storage loss, and chunk unload passed.
Ledger reload, server/dimension separation, day rollover, partial observations, corrections, and damaged-file preservation passed.
Original Base ESP native regression suite passed.
github_only_changes: Build workflow runs the native base-counter and Base ESP suites; canceled schematic CI step removed.
CLAUDE.md and release validation metadata added; runtime code matches the tested source snapshot.
limitations: Raid estimates use blocks, not unopened chest contents.
Natural-structure filtering is conservative; player builds using the same markers/palette can be excluded.
Server-side masking and unknown/erased/very small bases can be missed.
Sites are scoped by server address and dimension; distinct world shards using both the same scope and coordinates may merge.
